mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shipmentIntents, COALESCE(GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(updated_at),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))),0) AS oldestShipmentIntentSeconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_process_managers WHERE process_type='CANCELLATION' AND status IN ('WAITING_RECONCILIATION','COMPENSATION_REQUIRED','MANUAL_REVIEW')) AS cancellationRecoveryRequired FROM shop_orders WHERE status='CONFIRMED' AND shipment_intent_key IS NOT NULL
